parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Either by trigonometry, $\angle BAC=0.6435\ldots$ and $\angle ABC=(\pi-0.6435)/2$; or by Pythagoras, $AP=12\Rightarrow BP=3$ and $\tan\angle ABC=9/3$; or in triangle $PBC$, $\sin\angle ABC=3/\sqrt{10}$ or $\cos\angle ABC=\sqrt{10}/10$. M1
$\angle ABC=(\pi-0.6435)/2$, or $\tan^{-1}3$, or $\sin^{-1}(3/\sqrt{10})$, or $\cos^{-1}(\sqrt{10}/10)=1.24904\ldots=1.25$ radians (3 s.f.). A1 AG; final answer must be 1.25. A more accurate unrounded value shown as the final answer gets M1A0. If decimals are used, all values must be at least 4 s.f.
Total: 2

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$BC=\sqrt{3^2+9^2}=\sqrt{90}$, or $BC=9/\sin1.25$. M1 Correct method to find $BC$.
Area of sector $BCQ=\frac12(\text{their }BC)^2(\tan^{-1}3)$, or using $1.25$, giving about $56.21$ to $56.25$. M1 Correct sector-area formula using their $BC$, but not 9 or 15.
Area of triangle $PBC=13.4$ to $13.6$, or $\frac12\times9\times3=13.5$. B1
Shaded area $=56.21\ldots-13.5=42.7$ (or $42.8$ from permitted rounding). A1 AWRT.
Total: 4
